channel.title: Wokwi & Browser Simulators :: Coursebook Informatics
channel.description: A simulator shows a virtual board with LEDs, buttons and sensors in the browser. Your MicroPython code runs in it just like on the real board. You don’t need to install anything, only a browser. Simulator Boards Used for Wokwi Raspberry Pi Pico, ESP32 your own circuits with breadboard components, hardware.py, later Wi-Fi (P2) python.microbit.org micro:bit editor and simulator in one, sensors via sliders When to simulate?
